title: V3-03 existing reader Seek: seconds and measured percentage

requirement.scope: Explicit percentage seek within the currently rendered recording, using the existing reader dialog, player and quiet-admission route.

implementation: The existing Seek dialog accepts finite seconds or a terminal percentage sign; percentages are bounded to 0..100 and mapped to captured original PCM duration.

Before opening the modal, capture the exact last_audio object, ReadingAudio binding, reading-document object and signature, playback generation, WavePlayer session generation, original path and measured duration.

Revalidate source/library/lifetime and all captured identities after modal return and again inside the existing quiet-admitted action. Hidden/closing/destroyed owners, busy or cancelled work, changed source, replacement recording and same-text replacement tabs cannot reuse the old request.
WavePlayer.seek remains unchanged: existing paused behavior, PCM identity checks, A/B range policy, native ownership and explicit stopped-playback policy are retained.

coverage: Actual imported speech_dialog callback bodies and mutable closure state; actual ReadingDocument, ReadingAudio, PCM headers and WavePlayer. Only widgets and native MCI protocol are modeled.
0%,25%,50%,100%,fractional percentages and legacy seconds; paused seeks do not start a device.
Quiet admission keeps its existing hold/release semantics before a playing seek.
Malformed, negative, nonfinite, over-duration, over-100% and bounded-input failures before admission.
Missing or mismatched recording/binding/duration refuses modal opening.

Eleven independent freshness changes during both modal and quiet wait: Stop followed by clearing cancellation, direct player Stop, new recording, equal binding replacement, identical-text different tab, reading edit, source revocation, library replacement, duration change, hidden Close, and actual owner-ID destruction.
Actual PCM replacement after quiet wait still triggers the unchanged player identity refusal.
Existing A/B restriction, cancelled modal and pre-modal source revocation remain enforced.
portable_tests.fixture_peer_correction: The modeled progress controller is identity-hashable, matching real OperationProgress and the unchanged dict.fromkeys deduplication in play_when_quiet.

native_tests.coverage: The actual source-bound reader renders purpose-written two-second PCM, pauses explicitly, types 50%,100%,0.25 into its existing native TextEntryDialog, and checks the same player/session/path/duration/output identity/document with no extra narration during seek.
native_tests.scope: Current source and installed native reader lanes on an explicitly supplied output identity. No default endpoint fallback. The existing standalone reader-player probe is not claimed to exercise this dialog.

selection.portable_required: Add tests/ui/test_reader_playback.py to both source and installed component arrays; the 5d19 component workflow currently has zero occurrences.
selection.native_existing: Retain existing source/installed windows_reader_navigation_smoke.py invocations in the exact-output ordinary workflow.

primary_api_sources.evidence: The generic TextEntryDialog creates one direct child TextCtrl; native test does not assume an unavailable GetTextCtrl method.

verification.peer_review: voice_reading independently reviewed source, corrected 52-case fixture and final native extension; CLEAR. Parent reviewed the source delta; CLEAR.
